# Conyso Publishing

> Conyso Publishing is Conyso's imprint for quiz and reference books built from its free, sourced datasets, the Law Tome and the Bias Atlas. Its first book, True or Folklore? (coming soon), puts 100 famous stories to the test; each story page here gives the book's verdict (TRUE, FOLKLORE or DISPUTED), the one fact worth repeating, the popular version and the sources, and links to the Law Tome entry it is built from. The text is drafted with AI from sourced records and checked against those sources; the illustrations are made with AI. Corrections: https://conyso.com/lawtome/errata/
